+def _get_units_from_attrs(var) -> str:
+    """Extracts and formats the unit/units attribute of a variable, if any.
+
+    Looks for a ``"units"`` (or, failing that, ``"unit"``) entry in the
+    ``attrs`` of ``var`` and formats it for use in the one-line summary of a
+    variable (e.g. for the ``Dataset``/``DataArray`` ``__repr__``). Returns
+    an empty string if ``var`` has no ``attrs`` or no unit-like attribute is
+    present.
+    """
+    attrs = getattr(var, "attrs", None)
+    if not attrs:
+        return ""
+
+    units = attrs.get("units", attrs.get("unit"))
+    if units is None:
+        return ""
+
+    return f", in {units}"
+
+
+def _summarize_name_and_units(name, var) -> str:
+    """Combine a variable's name with its units (if any) for use as a
+    column header in the one-line summaries used by ``__repr__``."""
+    return f"{name}{_get_units_from_attrs(var)}"
+
